chapters.title: Welcome to Cloud Security: Your Digital Fortress 🏰
chapters.description: Discover why cloud security is critical, meet the CIA triad, and start your journey to becoming a cloud defender.

chapters.title: Cloud Foundations: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS & More ☁️
chapters.description: Uncover the core cloud service models and deployment types that shape every security decision.

chapters.title: The Shared Responsibility Model ⚖️
chapters.description: Master who secures what in AWS, Azure, and GCP – the foundation of all cloud security.

chapters.title: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Essentials 🔑
chapters.description: Learn users, groups, roles, policies, and MFA to control who gets in and what they can touch.

chapters.title: Data Protection: Encryption, Keys & DLP 🔐
chapters.description: Protect data at rest and in transit using encryption, key management, and data loss prevention strategies.

chapters.title: Securing the Cloud Network: VPCs & Firewalls 🌐
chapters.description: Design secure virtual networks, control traffic with firewalls, and segment resources like a pro.

chapters.title: Compute Security: Instances, Containers & Serverless ⚙️
chapters.description: Harden virtual machines, secure containers, and lock down serverless functions.

chapters.title: Application Security & DevSecOps 🧪
chapters.description: Build security into your CI/CD pipeline, protect APIs, and deploy a Web Application Firewall.

chapters.title: Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response 🚨
chapters.description: Detect threats, centralize logs, and respond to incidents before they become breaches.

chapters.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) 📜
chapters.description: Align cloud security with frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC2, and manage risk with CSPM tools.

chapters.title: Cloud Security Architecture & Well‑Architected Frameworks 🏛️
chapters.description: Design resilient, secure systems using proven patterns and the cloud well‑architected pillars.

chapters.title: Advanced Threats & Zero Trust: The Future 🚀
chapters.description: Explore AI‑powered attacks, threat modeling, and zero trust architecture to stay ahead.
